sections_target.text: Introduction

This document sets out the calibration steps I1 to be carried out annually on the gas circuit of the gas turbine, as indicated by the code Y1 above. The first draft of this document was prepared by Eng. Doaa Mohamed Shabana, field-tested by Eng. Marwa El-Sayed El-Hadidy, endorsed by General Manager Eng. Yousry Ahmed Abdel Maksoud, reviewed by Eng. Abdel Monem El-Emam, Manager of the Instruments and Electricity Department in the Inspection Sector of the East Delta Electricity Production Company, and approved by Eng. Fathy Mahmoud Ragab, Head of the Talkha Gas Turbine Station Sector.

It was endorsed by Eng. Samir Abdel Galil, General Manager of Inspection and Quality at the East Delta Electricity Production Company and MPIS Coordinator, and approved by Mr. Mahmoud Mohamed Sleiman, General Manager of Financial and Administrative Control and Supervisor of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector.
Safety precautions

items: Issue a work order, with an industrial safety category card available for the site workers
Fence off the area and use the appropriate warning signs
Use occupational safety and health equipment such as a safety helmet and safety shoes, etc.
The unit must be shut down and stopped before starting the maintenance work

2 digital voltmeters, occupational safety and health equipment

Trip the unit manually via (12 HA) Mech. Overspeed; the stop and speed ratio valve is observed to close
Disconnect all connections and return the cards to their places.

sections_target.text: Calibration of the governing pressure P2:

rows: Make sure the hydraulic oil pressure is zero and the stop and speed ratio valve is closed.
Disconnect the wires of the 96FG transducer from the adjacent box (JB25)

Simulate the transducer output with VCE values by making a jumper between pin (H07R) and PFG (C03R) on the calibrator panel, measure the voltage, and connect the voltmeter between pin (H07R) and earth A com.
Simulate the turbine speed NHP using an oscillator and a frequency counter by making a jumper between Freq. Source (C01), NHP (B02)
Connect the Freq. Count pins between B02, Acom.
Connect a voltmeter between pin 45 of the SSVD card and Acom (TRD signal).
Make a jumper to cut off firing by placing Logic 0 on pin x38 on the SSVD card so that the pressure governor can perform its function
Remove the SSVG card to prevent the control valve from opening.
Adjust the VCE voltage (transducer output) as per the following table:
Disconnect all the above connections, return the cards to their places, and make sure there are no alarms and that the turbine is Ready
